caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden object, possibly a decorative architectural element or furniture applique, centered on a plain, beige background. The top section features a semicircular fan shape rendered in green and brown hues, resembling stylized leaves with dark veins. Below this, there is a horizontal band in brown with curved extensions on both sides, alongside a series of small, white flowers and green leaves at the center. The middle portion is a bulbous, rounded form primarily shaded in blue with visible wood grain texture. The bottom portion tapers to a point and is adorned with green leaf-like shapes with black outlines, suggesting additional vegetal ornamentation. The object is colored using shades of green, brown, blue, white, and black, and occupies the center of the otherwise unadorned paper. The text "Ralph J. Lits Prettak" is printed in small size near the base of the object.
title: Finial, from Reredos
